jobs.title: Senior Energy Markets Analyst, PJM
jobs.description: Voltus runs demand response programs across North American wholesale markets and utilities. As the Senior Energy Markets Analyst for PJM, you will own our PJM utility programs end to end. You will run one established utility program and help launch a second, newer one. You will also support Product and Partnerships in sizing and designing the next set of PJM utility programs, where much of our future revenue and margin sits. This is a high-autonomy role. You will manage your own work, with your manager setting priorities and reviewing results rather than directing day-to-day tasks. For each program you own, you will be the go-to expert inside Voltus and the main contact for the utility. What you will do Run our PJM utility programs end to end: registrations, nominations, dispatch, performance calculations and settlements. Help launch a new program and identify the next ones with Product and Partnerships. Advise Product and Partnerships on program design, opportunity sizing and utility proposals. You will not draft formal regulatory filings. Explain program rules in plain language to Sales, customers and Dispatch Ops, and write to utilities and PJM on registration and settlement issues. Support PJM - ELRP (Load Management) registrations starting in 2028. Guide and review the work of co-op and junior analysts. This role has no direct reports. What success looks like Within 60 days, you know the established program well enough to run it without the team's involvement. Registrations, nominations, tests, events and quarterly settlements are on time and accurate, and your manager reviews rather than does. New program registrations are submitted on time with no missed deadlines, and enrolled MW is at or near target. Baseline and performance methodology is agreed with Engineering and Product before the first dispatch. A written playbook for the new program exists that someone else could pick up. Product, Partnerships, Dispatch Ops and utility contacts come to you directly. Your analysis has informed a program design discussion with Product and Partnerships. What you bring Required 3 to 5 years of hands-on energy markets experience in demand response or a closely related area (registrations, performance calculations, settlements), in any ISO or utility program. Advanced Excel or Google Sheets: trackers, baseline-versus-metered-load calculations, and settlement reconciliations that others can audit. Basic SQL: read-only queries with joins, aggregations and filters to pull site, interval and dispatch data. Basic Python, with familiarity with Pandas, to process interval data across many sites and automate repetitive registration and settlement prep. Clear written communication, including plain-language explanations of program rules and professional correspondence with utilities and ISOs. Ownership: you make judgment calls on ambiguous program rules, know when to escalate, and build process where none exists. Availability during core Eastern hours and during test and event windows. PJM, the utilities and all program deadlines run on Eastern time. Preferred PJM experience, in this order of relevance: DR programs (ELRP, utility DR programs in PJM states); settlements and performance calculations; capacity market basics (PLCs, nominations, delivery year calendar); wholesale market operations. Strong DR candidates from ERCOT, NYISO or MISO are encouraged to apply.Â  Please note that at this time, we do not sponsor visas or transfers for new hires. We expect that Voltans are working primarily from their home country. Working while traveling to other countries must be approved as per our Global Remote Travel Policy. jobs.title: Senior iOS Engineer, Foundations
jobs.description: We are seeking a Senior iOS Engineer to join Raya Foundations, the platform team that owns the shared foundation every other Raya engineering team builds on. On the client side that means the architecture of our iOS codebase, its modularization and build system, shared libraries and design-system components, CI and release tooling, crash and performance infrastructure, and the AI-collaborative development tooling our iOS engineers use every day. This is a senior client engineering role with deep technical impact across a large, long-lived swift iOS codebase. The ideal candidate has built and operated high-scale consumer iOS applications end to end, has been the engineer other iOS engineers come to for architecture and tooling, and is excited about modernizing a mature Swift codebase while keeping it shipping every week. Rather than owning one feature surface, you will partner with the product client teams, server engineering, and design to raise the engineering bar across the whole app. We offer comprehensive medical and dental coverage, $50 a day food delivery budget, equity based employment, a great culture, learning opportunities, unlimited vacation, 12 weeks paid parental leave, and we pay all employees $1,000 a year to go somewhere in the world that they've never been because of our values of human connection, empathy, and curiosity. Responsibilities Own the architecture of Raya's iOS codebase: set the patterns and best practices for state management, SwiftUI adoption, navigation, networking, and concurrency, and solve the hard client-side lifecycle problems that span teams. Drive modernization of a large, long-lived Swift codebase: modularization, SwiftUI alongside UIKit, Swift concurrency, and deliberate management of tech debt. Write the tech specs, make the trade-offs explicit, and sequence the work so it ships incrementally. Build the shared foundation other iOS engineers build on: design-system components, shared libraries, networking and persistence layers, and the dev harness (build times, CI, test infrastructure, release tooling). Build and roll out the AI-collaborative development tooling iOS engineers use every day, and set the standards for how we use it on the client. Improve client production health infrastructure: crash and performance monitoring, alerting, release quality, and the security posture of the app. Partner with server engineering on API design and client-server state sync, and with the product client teams so new features land on solid patterns. Raise the engineering bar through design reviews, code review, mentorship, and clear written specs. Requirements 5+ years of professional iOS development experience, with strong proficiency in Swift, UIKit, and MVVM. Strong experience with RxSwift or similar reactive programming frameworks, and with Redux-style state management patterns. A track record of shipping consumer mobile apps to large audiences, with strong judgment on architecture, performance, and user experience. jobs.title: Partner Solution Architect, Partner Center of Excellence
jobs.description: As the most trusted global leader in data-first contract lifecycle management (CLM) software, Agiloft helps organizations manage the end-to-end process of proposing, negotiating, signing, and leveraging contracts using our flexible Data-first Agreement Platform (DAP). With contract data as the foundation, customers quickly and collaboratively reach agreement and leverage contract visibility to thrive with competitive advantage. Employing powerful, pragmatic artificial intelligence as a legal force multiplier, and robust integration capabilities as a data liberator, organizations around the world trust Agiloftâs certified implementers to deliver connected, intelligent, and autonomous solutions across the entire contract lifecycle. Top analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC agree, all showing Agiloft as a leader in the CLM space. Our no code platform is easily managed and administered by business users, which is why Agiloft is the contract you keep: nearly a full 100% of new customers are satisfied with their initial implementations, and some 97% of customers renew every year. Ours is a growing, vibrant, successful company that is at the forefront of a market that is becoming a must-have for all organizations. We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day. Our working philosophy is that âEX = CXâ: when employee experience is excellent, so is customer experience. We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no-questions-asked wellness day. Position Overview Â  Agiloft's customers rely on our Ecosystem of System Integration (SI) partners to help them design, build and deliver solutions on the Agiloft platform. This role is designed to help our partners build robust capabilities within their organization and ultimately ensure our customers are realizing maximum value from the platform. As Partner Solution Architect, you'll support the partners as a technical advisor for partner-led implementations from kickoff through go-live. You'll guide SIs on architecture, integrations, data sync, and configuration. When something breaks, you'll figure out whether it's a configuration issue, an integration issue, or a real product defect, and get it to the right owner. You'll sit in the Partner Center of Excellence, the team responsible for making partner delivery repeatable and high quality. Our Partner Alliance Managers own the overall relationship with each partner and this role will be responsible for the successful technical outcome and capability development. You'll work daily with Sales, Professional Services, Product, Engineering, and Support, and you'll turn what you learn on each project into playbooks the whole ecosystem can use. Â  Job Responsibilities What you'll do Guide Partners to Go-live Serve as the product & technical point of contact for SI partners and their customers during the implementation project and through go-live. Advise on solution architecture, integration design, data synchronization, and configuration best practices across Agiloft's platform: core CLM, procurement and source-to-pay workflows, ERP sync (such as SAP S/4HANA), APIs and MCP-based orchestration, and AI and analytics capabilities. Help partners separate out-of-the-box capability from custom implementation work so each fix lands with the right owner. Own the Technical Escalation Path Act as the Tier 3 technical resource for partner-led projects. Triage and reproduce issues, document them clearly, and log true defects and enhancement requests to Product and Engineering in Jira. Join partner and customer working sessions when a blocker needs Agiloft in the room. Hand accounts off cleanly to Support at transition, with documented configuration and open items. Enable the Ecosystem Build and deliver partner training, webinars, and learning content with Product and go-to-market teams. Work with Product and Engineering to stand up and maintain partner sandboxes, test environments, and knowledge base access. Support the change management and promote the value of monthly releases into the partner ecosystem. Build the Playbook Create and maintain implementation playbooks, a known-issue library, escalation runbooks, and environment setup guides. Feed patterns from real projects back into enablement, documentation, and the product roadmap. What Success Looks Like in Year One Partner-led go-lives land on schedule, with fewer slipping because of unresolved technical blockers. Technical escalations from partners reach a clear owner quickly, with reproducible detail, and resolve faster. Product and Engineering receive structured, prioritized signal from partner projects instead of ad hoc pulls. Product and Engineering receive a steady, well-documented stream of implementation feedback that shapes the roadmap. A working go-live toolkit exists and partners actually use it: playbooks, known-issue library, runbooks, reference architectures, and environment guides. Support inherits cleaner, better-documented accounts at handoff. Target metrics: e.g. on-time go-live rate, median time to resolve partner escalations, escalations per quarter, training events delivered. Other duties as assigned. Required Qualifications What you'll bring 5+ years in a technical, customer- or partner-facing implementation role: solution architecture, professional services, implementation or integration consulting, or sales engineering with post-sale delivery. Agiloft certification, or relevant platform certifications (Salesforce, SAP, cloud). Hands-on experience designing and troubleshooting enterprise integrations including REST APIs, webhooks, authentication patterns (OAuth, JWT), and data sync between systems of record. Working knowledge of the systems CLM connects to, such as Salesforce, ERP (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite), and Procurement relevant ISVs Strong troubleshooting instincts. You can isolate whether an issue is configuration, integration, or product defect, and explain it precisely to engineers and executives alike. Solution design skills: you can translate business requirements into a technical design and explain the trade-offs to both technical and business stakeholders. Experience guiding external partners or customers while working across Product, Engineering, and Support. Exposure to AI-enabled workflows, LLM tooling, or MCP-based integrations. A builder's habit of turning one-off fixes into reusable documentation and process. Preferred Qualifications Nice to have Integration middleware experience: Workato, MuleSoft, or Boomi. Background in CLM, procurement or source-to-pay, CPQ, or related enterprise workflow platforms; hands-on experience implementing a CLM platform is a strong plus. Prior work at or alongside SI and consulting partners. Exposure to ISV/managed-package delivery, versioning, and enterprise deployment considerations. Prior experience working directly with or inside SI or consulting partners. Ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace is our priority. We are committed to an environment of acceptance where you are free to bring your full self to work. All employment decisions at Agiloft are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national or social ethnic origin, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, parental status, marital status, Veteran status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. If you have a need that requires accommodation during the recruiting process, please let us know by contacting Director, Talent Acquisition, Brad Toothman at brad.toothman@agiloft.com. Â  Applicants from underrepresented groups such as minorities, veterans, or individuals with disabilities encouraged to apply. Applications will be reviewed as submitted. There will be no application deadline for this opportunity. Lifeforce is hiring a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own every message a lead or member gets from us after the first click. You'll run email, SMS, push, and in-app messaging across the full journey: turning leads into members, getting new members through their first diagnostics and clinician visit, keeping members engaged with their protocols, and bringing back the ones who drift.

This is a hands-on role. You will build the journeys, write and test the messages, set up the segments, and read the results yourself. You'll use AI tools to move faster on copy, personalization, and analysis, and you'll build a lifecycle program that scales as our membership, clinician network, and Ultimate Longevity Center (ULC) locations grow.

You'll work closely with growth, product, clinical, coaching, and member experience teams. Paid acquisition brings people to the door. You make sure they walk in, stay, and get results.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Nurture & Conversion

Build and run nurture journeys that turn leads from paid, organic, and referral channels into members. Work with the growth team to match messaging to the ads, landing pages, and offers that brought each lead in. Test offers, timing, and content to raise lead-to-member conversion.

Onboarding & Activation

Own the new-member journey from sign-up through first lab draw, results review, and first clinician and coach visits. Cut drop-off at each step by finding where members get stuck and fixing it with clear, timely messages. Partner with member experience and operations so messages match what members actually see and do.

Retention, Engagement & Win-Back

Build programs that keep members engaged with their protocols, follow-up diagnostics, and coaching. Drive adoption of supplements, prescriptions, and other offerings where they fit a member's plan. Run churn-prevention, win-back, and referral programs.

Segmentation, Testing & Analytics

Build segments and triggers from member behavior, lifecycle stage, and program data. Run a steady testing roadmap across subject lines, content, channels, timing, and offers. Own lifecycle reporting: conversion, activation, retention, churn, and revenue by journey. Use AI tools like Claude to draft and personalize content, analyze results, and speed up production.

Platform & Compliance

Own our lifecycle platform setup, data flows, templates, and deliverability. Work with clinical and compliance teams to keep every message accurate and compliant with HIPAA, TCPA, and CAN-SPAM. Document journeys and processes so the program can scale without adding headcount.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner with growth on full-funnel strategy and shared conversion goals. Work with product on in-app messaging, onboarding flows, and member data. Bring member insights back to marketing, product, and clinical teams.

Qualifications

Required

4+ years of lifecycle, CRM, or retention marketing experience in a consumer subscription, DTC, or membership business. Hands-on experience building journeys in a platform like Braze, Customer.io, Iterable, or Klaviyo. Strong copywriting skills across email, SMS, and push. Comfort with data: segmentation, A/B testing, cohort analysis, and reporting. SQL is a plus. Regular use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to speed up content and analysis. Clear written and verbal communication. Self-directed and effective in a fully remote environment.

Preferred

Experience in digital health, telehealth, wellness, or healthcare. Working knowledge of HIPAA, TCPA, and CAN-SPAM requirements. Experience with Segment, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or a similar data stack. Experience at a startup or high-growth company. Experience building a lifecycle program from scratch.

  • Tests everything and lets the data decide.
  • Comfortable doing the detailed work, not just planning it.
  • Raises problems early and comes with a proposed fix.
  • Comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

  • Company-provided computer and other required equipment

But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust.

 

In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information.

 

  • Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment
  • Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories
  • Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance

Job Title: Patient Care Advocate 

Job Location: Remote


About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview: 

As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. 


What You’ll Do: 

  • Patient Enrollment & Eligibility: Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. 
  • Prescription Coverage: Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. 
  • Cost-Sharing & Payment: Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. 
  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. 
  • Refills & Continued Use: Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. 
  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. 


What We’re Looking For: 

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes
  • Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies
  • A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access
  • The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment

Success Factors for Working from Home 

  • Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. 
  • Ergonomics: A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment. 
  • Reliable Internet Connection: Stable, high-speed internet with a minimum bandwidth of 10 Mbps downstream and 5 Mbps upstream. 
  • Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace: A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. 
  • Tech-Savvy: Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. 
  • Self-motivation & Independence: Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. 
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. 
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. 


Compensation & Perks 

  • Hourly Pay: $16.50 per hour 
  • Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. 
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. 
  • Cell Phone Benefits: $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). 
  • Generous Referral Program: Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts. 
  • Comprehensive Training: Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. 
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. 
  • Work-from-Home Convenience: Save time, and money, and reduce your environmental footprint. 
  • Inclusive Culture: We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. 

What Success Looks Like: 

  • Reduced out-of-pocket costs for patients through effective cost-sharing and copay assistance 
  • Timely and accurate processing of prescription claims and approvals 
  • High patient satisfaction with the program’s support and streamlined experience 
  • Compliance with program requirements and monitoring of patient eligibility for ongoing assistance 

Why Join Us? 

  • Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications 
  • Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors 
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package 
  • A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture 

Ready to Make an Impact? 

Join us in making prescription medications more affordable and accessible for those who need them most. If you're ready to help make a difference, we'd love to hear from you! 

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

To ensure that your work will not be used at Fluence, we’ve made it unrelated to healthcare: Build “LendLoop”: a neighborhood tool-lending board with automated workflows A simple app where neighbors list tools they are willing to lend, request to borrow from each other, and receive automated notifications and reminders handled by n8n. Stack Next.js (App Router) Clerk for authentication Convex for data + backend logic n8n (self-hosted via Docker or n8n Cloud) for workflow automation TypeScript Requirements Public page The fictional company name is LendLoop . Short tagline, e.g. “Borrow what you need. Lend what you don’t.” Show: A read-only list of available tools (name and category only, no owner details), pulled from Convex. A “Sign in to lend or borrow” button wired to Clerk. Authenticated experience Only signed-in users can: List a tool with: name category (power tools, garden, kitchen, camping, etc.) condition short description Request to borrow a tool for a date range. Approve or decline requests on their own tools. Mark a loan as returned. Show: All tools with availability status, filterable by category. “My listings”, “My requests”, and “Incoming requests” views. Nice, minimal layout. Roles & rules Have two roles: admin : Can remove any listing, view all loans, and mark a lender as “Trusted Lender”. user : Can create, edit, and delete only their own listings, and act only on requests involving their own tools or their own borrowing. Implement the above role-based access control with best practices, enforced in Convex functions, not only in the UI. Automation with n8n Build at least two n8n workflows: Request notification: when a borrow request is created or changes status, Convex calls an n8n Webhook. The workflow notifies the relevant user (email, Slack, Discord, or a logged mock notification is fine) using only the fields it needs. Overdue reminders: a scheduled workflow runs daily, fetches overdue loans from a Convex HTTP endpoint, sends a reminder to each borrower, and writes the reminder status back to Convex. Secure the integration in both directions: Sign webhook payloads (e.g. HMAC with a shared secret) and verify signatures on the receiving side. Keep secrets in environment variables and n8n credentials, never in code or exported workflow JSON. Make write-backs idempotent so retries do not create duplicate records or reminders. Handle failures with retries and an error workflow (or equivalent) so failed runs are visible and never fail silently. (Bonus) Show recent automation activity on each loan in the app, e.g. “Reminder sent 2 days ago”. Deliverables A GitHub repository with the app source code. Exported n8n workflow JSON files in the repository. Build “LendLoop”: a neighborhood tool-lending board with automated workflows

A simple app where neighbors list tools they are willing to lend, request to borrow from each other, and receive automated notifications and reminders handled by n8n.

Stack

  • Next.js (App Router)

  • Clerk for authentication

  • Convex for data + backend logic

  • n8n (self-hosted via Docker or n8n Cloud) for workflow automation

  • TypeScript

Public page

  • The fictional company name is LendLoop.

  • Short tagline, e.g. “Borrow what you need. Lend what you don’t.”

  • Show:

  • A read-only list of available tools (name and category only, no owner details), pulled from Convex.

  • A “Sign in to lend or borrow” button wired to Clerk.

  • Only signed-in users can:

  • List a tool with:

  • name

  • category (power tools, garden, kitchen, camping, etc.)

  • condition

  • short description

  • Request to borrow a tool for a date range.

  • Approve or decline requests on their own tools.

  • Mark a loan as returned.

  • Show:

  • All tools with availability status, filterable by category.

  • “My listings”, “My requests”, and “Incoming requests” views.

  • Nice, minimal layout.

  • Have two roles:

  • admin:

  • user:

  • Implement the above role-based access control with best practices, enforced in Convex functions, not only in the UI.

  • Build at least two n8n workflows:

  • Request notification: when a borrow request is created or changes status, Convex calls an n8n Webhook. The workflow notifies the relevant user (email, Slack, Discord, or a logged mock notification is fine) using only the fields it needs.

  • Overdue reminders: a scheduled workflow runs daily, fetches overdue loans from a Convex HTTP endpoint, sends a reminder to each borrower, and writes the reminder status back to Convex.

  • Secure the integration in both directions:

  • Sign webhook payloads (e.g. HMAC with a shared secret) and verify signatures on the receiving side.

  • Keep secrets in environment variables and n8n credentials, never in code or exported workflow JSON.

  • Make write-backs idempotent so retries do not create duplicate records or reminders.

  • Handle failures with retries and an error workflow (or equivalent) so failed runs are visible and never fail silently.

  • (Bonus) Show recent automation activity on each loan in the app, e.g. “Reminder sent 2 days ago”.

  • A GitHub repository with the app source code.

  • Exported n8n workflow JSON files in the repository.

  • A README covering local setup (including n8n, e.g. a docker-compose file), environment variables, architecture, and your security and data-minimization decisions.

  • A short note on what you would change to run this in production.

  • Integration design, reliability, and error handling (n8n)

raw_payload.description:
Headquarters: Toronto - Remote

About the Role

As a Growth Product Manager, HTS Media, you will own the roadmap for growing advertiser demand across brands: more qualified pipeline, faster campaign launches and higher advertiser spend within Hopper's ecosystem, working closely with engineering leadership, the sales team, Ad Operations and Account Management. This is a builder role: you will start by owning the roadmap for sales pipeline and sales efficiency, using AI-assisted systems to create demand and make every seller faster, then grow into owning the platform roadmap, including the campaign buying interfaces, in partnership with engineering leadership. In your first year, you'll be judged on the pipeline your systems create, how much faster campaigns go from signed to live, and growth in spend per advertiser.

What would your day-to-day look like

  • Own the roadmap for sales pipeline and sales efficiency, with goals and success metrics tied to a revenue target

  • Build AI-powered systems that generate demand, from account research and signal-based targeting to personalized outreach and follow-up, and measure the pipeline and meetings they produce

  • Grow into owning the platform roadmap for the campaign buying interfaces with engineering leadership: write the specs and decide what gets built, and in what order

  • Work with Ad Operations to remove friction between a signed campaign and a live one

  • Put insights into the buying interface, such as forecasts, benchmarks and media plan recommendations

  • Use SQL on booking, search and campaign data to size opportunities, find advertiser results and decide what to build next

  • Run demand experiments across channels such as LinkedIn, email and events, and track results in internal dashboards

  • Support HTS Media positioning and reusable sales materials (deck templates, one-pagers and case studies), and the HTS Media website and offers site

An ideal candidate has

  • 4+ years of experience in product management or growth at a technology company, ideally in B2B SaaS, marketplaces or ad tech; experience in online advertising or travel is a plus

  • A track record of owning a roadmap and shipping product with engineering that moved a measurable growth metric, such as pipeline, conversion, time to launch or spend per account

  • Hands-on experience building AI-assisted or automated workflows that a real sales team used, with tools such as Clay, n8n, Zapier or Make, and LLM APIs (equivalents are fine), and the ability to describe what you built and what it produced

  • Strong SQL on a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, and comfort turning booking, search and ad-serving data into decisions, forecasts and in-product insights

  • Excellent writing and specification skills, and the ability to work with engineering leadership and communicate clearly with advertisers and internal teams

  • Self-driven and organized, and comfortable building without a playbook in a fast-growing business

Perks and benefits of working with us

  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and upsides of pre-IPO equity packages

  • Hopper covers 100% of the premiums for group insurance plan

  • Hopper offers life, short term and long term disability coverage

  • HSA that covers eligible medical and dental expenses

  • All employees and dependents have access to Dialogue’s telemedicine services, anytime, anywhere

  • All employees have access to an RRSP plan with automatic pre-tax withdrawals per pay

  • Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Carrot Cash travel stipend

  • Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk AND Work-from-home stipend

  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business

  • Open communication with management and company leadership

  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact

About Hopper

At Hopper, we're building the leading travel technology platform in the world, and we're doing it by solving real problems for real travelers globally. Our Hopper consumer booking platforms and HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), our B2B business, work together to give travelers something the industry has never reliably offered: transparency, flexibility, and real savings on every trip. We combine massive amounts of data and AI with proprietary fintech products to make that happen, not just another booking engine, but a fundamentally better way to plan and experience travel for our customers and our partners. We are proof that better-for-the-customer and better-for-the-business can be one in the same

And we're continuing to grow fast! The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times, with 70% of our users being Gen Z and Millennials, next-generation travelers. Today, our biggest opportunity is powering travel fintech, commerce, and loyalty for some of the biggest brands in the industry. Our first HTS partnership with Capital One helped launch a dedicated travel portal for a major financial brand's cardholders, and we've since expanded across some of the biggest names in travel and banking, including Air Canada, Uber, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), and Nubank, powering everything from a single fintech integration to a full end-to-end travel loyalty portal.

That's our trajectory: we started as a small, disruptive app within the travel space, and now we're the engine under the hood powering how Travel Tech works.

What that looks like in practice:

  • Billions of dollars in travel and travel fintech move through Hopper and HTS every year

  • Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Disruption Assistance for Any Reason, post exceptionally strong customer satisfaction because the terms are clear and resolutions are instant, no questions asked

  • Nearly 30% of app customers add a fintech product to their booking, and those customers are 1.6x more likely to book with us again

  • HTS now drives more than 90% of the business, proof of how fast B2B has scaled

  • Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies) can plug the company’s fintech, commerce and AI solutions into their own channels, whether that's a single integration or a full end-to-end travel portal

Come take off with us!

#LI-Remote

At Hopper, we leverage AI-driven tools to assist our team in efficiently reviewing applications. These tools help us assess qualifications fairly and objectively. By submitting your application, you acknowledge the use of these automated screening technologies.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/hopper-growth-product-manager-hts-media

Experience working closely with product management and engineering throughout development, and influencing decisions beyond your own team. Strong communication and storytelling skills, including presenting to senior leaders and bringing partners along. Good judgment about when to challenge assumptions, when to seek more context, and when to make a decision. Consistent use of AI tools in your day-to-day design workflow (strongly preferred), with an informed point of view on where they help and where they don’t. Nice to Have Experience designing consumer financial products, such as cash advance, banking, payments, or lending Experience prototyping or building in code, including with AI coding tools. What Success Looks Like In your first few months, you’ll build a deep understanding of our customers, cash products, and business through shipping; build trusted relationships with your design and cross-functional partners; and form a clear point of view on where the experience should go. Why Join Us Lead design for the products at the center of Tilt’s business, with meaningful customer and business impact. Set both the experience and the visual direction for a critical financial product. Join a team that values strong design judgment, constructive debate, and thoughtful collaboration. Work directly with product-minded partners who care deeply about customers and shipping useful products. Shape how design operates, including how the team builds with AI, as the product organization evolves. Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you. What you'll get at Tilt Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement. Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards. Visibility is yours : You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly. About the role

Members of Technical Staff own features end to end. You'll work with the clinicians and operators who use what we build, scope the problem, design and build the solution across the stack, deploy it and follow how it performs in production. Our engineering team is flat, with no sub-teams, so you'll work across the whole platform. We build with AI coding agents every day and expect you to do the same.

  • Design and build AI agents and automated workflows for clinic operations, such as insurance benefits verification, prior authorizations, patient intake, claims and clinical documentation

  • Build features for clinicians, patients and families, and our internal operations team, on web and mobile

  • Take ambiguous problems from 0 to 1, working with operators and clinicians to define the problem, write the spec and ship a first version

  • Design the services, data models and APIs behind your features and manage the infrastructure as code

  • Own your services in production: deployments, monitoring and incident response

  • Write evals for model-facing features and track the metrics of the workflows you ship

  • Work with protected health information (PHI) safely, with least-privilege access, no PHI in logs and auditable changes

  • Build and maintain the skills, plugins, MCP integrations and review bots our engineers use with Claude Code and Codex

Our stack

  • Backend: Python (our primary language for new services), Kotlin with Hasura (GraphQL) on our established platform, plus TypeScript (NestJS) and some Go

  • Frontend and mobile: React, Next.js, React Native

  • Data: PostgreSQL (including pgvector), Snowflake

  • Workflows and contracts: Temporal, gRPC/Protobuf

  • Infrastructure: AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS), Terraform, GitHub Actions, Datadog, LaunchDarkly

  • AI: Claude and OpenAI models, Claude Code and Codex, with our own skills, plugins, MCP integrations and an AI code-review bot

Must-haves

  • 5+ years of experience building and shipping production software

  • Recent, hands-on experience using or building AI harnesses: the layer around a model or coding agent (project instructions, tools and MCP servers, skills, hooks, subagents, evals), not only calls to a model API. You can show what you set up or built.

  • At least one personal project you built and published on the web, live and usable by anyone, ideally a SaaS with payments working (e.g. Stripe). Share the link when you apply.

What we're looking for

  • A track record of owning products or features end to end, from an unclear problem to a system people depend on

  • Strong full-stack skills in Python and TypeScript, with experience across frontend, backend, databases and cloud infrastructure

  • Comfort working in a large, established codebase

  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs, including tool use, agent orchestration, structured outputs, retrieval and evals (LangGraph, an agents SDK or similar)

  • Daily use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. You know how to set them up for a codebase (project instructions, skills, MCP servers, hooks, subagents), run several tasks in parallel and review their output carefully. If you haven't heard of Claude Code, this role is likely not a fit.

  • Good product sense and the ability to make solid UI decisions without a dedicated designer, using our component library

  • High agency: you unblock yourself, look for context and ask questions when you need to

  • Clear written communication. The team is distributed across time zones and most decisions happen in specs, PRs and tickets.

Nice to have

  • Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry (HIPAA, payer and claims workflows, EHR integrations, HL7/FHIR)

  • Temporal or another durable workflow engine

  • React Native

  • Running LLM evaluations or safety checks on model output in production

  • Having built your own agent harness, MCP server or plugin for a coding agent

  • Open-source work or internal tools that other people use

jobs.description: Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States In 1933, Harry Beck introduced a radically different map of the London Underground. Rather than faithfully depicting the geography of London, he simplified the sprawling transit network into clean lines, clear connections, and a system that anyone could navigate. Distances were distorted, angles were standardized, and unnecessary details disappeared. The result was something far more useful than a geographically accurate map: a way for millions of people to understand a complex system and confidently find their way through it. Beck understood something fundamental. The best way to explain something complicated isn't to show people everything. It's to understand what matters to them and make that unmistakably clear. At Mercury, we believe great product marketing works the same way. Banking* and payments can be complex, but the value they create for customers shouldn't be. Our job is to understand what people need, find the essence of what we're building, and help customers see how it can make their lives better. We're a financial technology company building products that help ambitious businesses do more with their money. From everyday banking and payments to international money movement and emerging capabilities like agentic payments, we're making complex financial workflows feel remarkably simple. We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager to help bring these products to market, communicate their value, and make sure customers discover and use what we're building. This role sits at the intersection of Product, Marketing, and Revenue. You'll develop positioning, lead go-to-market strategies, drive successful product launches, and identify opportunities to increase adoption and revenue. We care deeply about craft, but successful product marketing is about more than a beautiful campaign or a well-executed announcement. It's about understanding customers, building an effective plan, and driving meaningful results. *Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Build a deep understanding of how founders and finance teams manage money, what challenges they face, and why they choose one financial product over another. You’ll build and use existing workflows, automations, and repeatable processes that improve how you approach research, launch execution, competitive intelligence, and other core responsibilities. Help more customers discover and use Mercury. Partner with Product, Lifecycle, Activation, and Revenue to drive adoption of banking and payments capabilities. Identify growth opportunities, test hypotheses, and improve product usage over time. Become an expert on our market. Develop a sharp understanding of the banking and payments competitive landscape, including emerging fintech products and traditional financial institutions. Translate market insights into differentiated positioning and actionable recommendations. Equip our Revenue teams to win. Build trusted relationships with customer-facing teams and develop the competitive intelligence, battlecards, messaging, and training they need to communicate Mercury's value confidently and accurately. Work with exceptional cross-functional partners. Collaborate with Product, Brand, Creative, Lifecycle, and Revenue to bring go-to-market strategies to life. Help shape strong campaign briefs and channel strategies, drawing on specialized creative expertise when needed. Connect marketing to business impact. Define clear objectives for launches and growth initiatives, track meaningful performance indicators, and communicate what worked, what didn't, and what we should do next. Own the full picture. Manage multiple projects and product areas simultaneously, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and prioritize the work that will have the greatest impact on Mercury and its customers. You might be a great fit if you: Have 2-3 years of B2B product marketing experience and have taken meaningful ownership of product launches and go-to-market initiatives. Have successfully brought new products or features to market and can explain the business impact of your work. Know how to build a complete GTM strategy, from customer insight and positioning through launch execution, field readiness, and post-launch measurement. Are an AI-native operator who goes beyond using AI for basic tasks. You've built workflows, automations, or systems that meaningfully improve the efficiency or quality of your work and your team's, and you're constantly experimenting with new ways to work better. Are deeply curious about customers and naturally look for the insights behind their behaviors, needs, and decisions. Can translate complex products and capabilities into clear, compelling messaging. Understand that great product marketing extends beyond launches into product adoption, competitive positioning, and revenue growth. Are comfortable using customer feedback, data, and experimentation to evaluate and improve marketing performance. Enjoy working closely with Product, Marketing, and Revenue teams and know how to build trusted relationships across functions. Can manage several competing priorities, make good decisions with incomplete information, and independently move important work forward.   • Measure the impact honestly, then do the next one. Kill what didn't move; double down on what did.
  • Run as an autonomous team — pick the target, ship the thing, own the outcome.

You should:

  • Have shipped something real -  a product, a tool, a company, or an open-source project people actually use.
  • Be dangerous across the stack: PMs who can prototype, engineers with product taste. 
  • Have strong opinions about AI products and the judgment to recognize fast when one of them is wrong.
  • Hands experience building AI products with AI, and knowledge about RAG, evals, agent harnesses a plus
  • Move fast and measure. Expect most experiments to fail and treat that as the price of finding the ones that don't.
  • Care about craft where it's impactful and resist polishing what isn't.
  • Communicate clearly and own outcomes - we want real business impact, customer time/pain saved, and a path to scaling what works

Learn more about what we're building:

  • Mercury Command — Complete financial work end-to-end with AI. Tell Mercury what to do in natural language; it stages the action and executes with your approval.
  • Mercury MCP & CLI — Give your AI agents direct access to verified financial data, or work with your Mercury account straight from the terminal.
  • The bank of the future knows your business — Immad on what we're building toward and why now is the moment.

What happens next?

Submit your application and our recruiting team will follow up. We're genuinely open to connecting with founders and teams at any stage — whether you're a strong fit for something we're actively building toward right now, or this is the start of a longer relationship we pick back up when the opportunity is right. If you're building, we want to know you.

jobs.description: Headquarters: Remote UK At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. At Affirm, we’re reimagining how people access and experience financial products. Our commitment to clarity, honesty, and empathy fuels every design decision across all of our user experiences. We’re looking for a Content Designer II to help create clear, useful, trustworthy, and compelling product experiences that make it easier for people to understand and use Affirm. About the team In this role, you’ll work as an embedded partner on a product team, collaborating closely with Product Design, Research, Product Management, Engineering, Brand, Legal, Compliance, and Customer Experience. You’ll bring strong writing skills, customer empathy, and product thinking to important product work. You’ll ask thoughtful questions, explain your rationale clearly, and advocate for simple, transparent experiences that help customers make informed decisions. You’ll use content strategy, systems thinking, and UX writing to help teams create experiences that are simple, transparent, and customer-centered. You’ll also contribute to Affirm’s growing Content Design practice by sharing feedback, participating in team rituals, helping strengthen guidelines and patterns, and partnering with other content designers. This role is ideal for a collaborative, curious, and customer-oriented content designer who is ready to grow their craft while making meaningful contributions to product experiences. Work cross-functionally with Product Design, Research, Product Management, Engineering, Brand, Legal, Compliance, and Customer Experience from early ideas through launch and optimization. Help teams understand customer problems, identify content and usability opportunities, and make thoughtful decisions about how product experiences should work and communicate. Role Description

As the Marketing Operations Manager, you will serve as a deeply embedded, data-oriented partner to the Marketing team and help the business understand and drive performance across the Marketing-to-Revenue funnel.

You will analyze the funnel from marketing engagement through qualification, pipeline, and revenue. You’re focused on identifying growth opportunities, conversion gaps, leakage, handoff issues and translating those findings into clear recommendations for Marketing, SDR, Sales, and RevOps leaders.

This is not a traditional reporting or martech administration role. Your primary value will be your ability to frame ambiguous business questions, diagnose the underlying drivers of performance, distinguish signal from noise, and help cross-functional teams make better operating and investment decisions.

You will also be expected to use AI and automation extensively to reduce repetitive analytical work, accelerate insight generation, and spend more time on interpretation, problem solving, and decision support.

Responsibilities

  • Own analysis of the Marketing-to-Revenue funnel from engagement and qualification through pipeline progression and revenue.
  • Identify opportunities, conversion gaps, funnel leakage, performance anomalies, and handoff issues across Marketing, SDR, and Sales.
  • Connect marketing activity to downstream pipeline and revenue outcomes to help inform investment and prioritization decisions.
  • Build clear analyses and reporting that surface meaningful trends, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners to improve lifecycle definitions, lead scoring, routing, SLAs, and measurement frameworks where funnel analysis identifies opportunities.
  • Partner with Marketing SLG, RevOps, SDR, Sales, Analytics, and Systems teams to resolve cross-functional funnel and data-quality issues.
  • Use AI and automation to accelerate query development, recurring reporting, anomaly detection, synthesis, and first-pass insight generation while remaining accountable for validation and final recommendations.

Requirements

  • Experience analyzing B2B marketing and sales funnels from marketing engagement through pipeline and revenue.
  • Strong analytical judgment and demonstrated ability to diagnose ambiguous business or funnel-performance problems.
  • Experience working with Salesforce data and familiarity with Marketo or another B2B marketing automation platform.
  • Experience using BI or analytics tools to explore, measure, and communicate funnel performance.
  • Working knowledge of SQL or sufficient fluency to independently inspect and analyze structured data.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Experience translating analysis into clear recommendations and business actions rather than stopping at reporting.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working within Revenue Operations or in a highly integrated Marketing and RevOps environment.
  • Experience partnering directly with Demand Generation, Marketing Operations, Data Science, SDR, and Sales teams.
  • Experience improving lead scoring, lifecycle stages, routing, SLAs, attribution, or funnel measurement.
  • Experience building reusable analytical frameworks or standardized operating metrics.
  • Experience using AI tools to improve analytical workflows while maintaining strong validation and quality controls.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

This role is not available in Zone 1

$152,200—$206,000 USD

$135,300—$183,100 USD

Production MLOps Expertise: Demonstrated experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines for ML models and integrating them into service-oriented architectures (SOA). LLM Deployment: Hands-on experience fine-tuning, deploying, and managing Large Language Models (LLMs) in a production environment, including knowledge of prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and cost optimization. Software Engineering Rigor: Proven ability to write high-quality, maintainable, scalable, and well-tested production code. Proficiency with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP) and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes). According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all. Additionally, one-third of the world’s population – 2 billion people – live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible. Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind “getting help,” we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. This means a successful SE at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of IoT hardware and sensors, hands-on installation/deployment scenarios, carrier networks, cloud infrastructure, and third-party system integrations (via our open API) to ensure the proper technical solution is presented to our customers. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. Educate customers on technical aspects of APIs, and be able to deploy scripts leveraging the Samsara API to a testing environment on demand. Be an advocate for your AE's, prospects, and customers when it comes to internal tech conversations. Headquarters: New York, US, Canada, Remote

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.


About the team

Brand Studio team works on a variety of brand-centric projects for Stripe, from our brand standards to campaigns, events, IRL experiences, packaging, digital products, and even printed publications. The brand designers on this team are multidisciplinary in nature, able to design robust visual systems, art direction, and craft surfaces that focus on brand and product storytelling. 

Collaborating with other teams at Stripe, as well as external partners, we raise the quality and consistency of experiences with the Stripe brand IRL, virtually, and everywhere in between. We craft the creative vision and strategy for different types of projects and audiences, and amplify them across various mediums, channels, objects to environments, and digital and physical experiences.

About Stripe Creative Lab

Stripe Creative Lab aims to create breakthrough, culturally resonant, and exquisitely crafted projects that reveal Stripe’s magic in surprising ways. We dedicate ourselves to meticulously crafting the work to ensure the highest possible creative quality. The work is experimental, often starts with ambiguous briefs and requires finding a way where others might deem it impossible. We are making it up as we go, and that’s the way we love to work.

 

What you’ll do

You’ll be joining a highly creative team working across digital experiences, interactive projects, physical installations, experimental technology, and whatever else an idea might require. The work often begins without an obvious technical solution and sometimes without knowing exactly what form the final project should take.

As a Design Engineer, you’ll work closely with designers, art directors, and producers to figure out what’s possible, prototype ideas quickly, and turn ambitious creative concepts into working experiences. You’ll bring deep technical expertise in at least one area of creative engineering, alongside the curiosity and technical range to work confidently beyond it.

A significant amount of our work lives on the internet, so you should be comfortable independently building and shipping highly crafted digital experiences. Other projects may involve hardware, physical computing, unusual displays, installations, or technical systems we haven’t encountered before. You won’t be expected to be an expert in everything, but you should be excited to learn, experiment, and know when to bring in specialists.

Responsibilities

  • Prototype and build highly crafted, experimental digital experiences, interactive projects, and creative tools
  • Work closely with designers and art directors to translate ambitious creative direction into technically excellent experiences, while contributing your own judgment to make the work better
  • Explore emerging technologies and unfamiliar technical approaches, quickly determining what is possible and how best to build it
  • Independently navigate ambiguous technical problems, moving pragmatically from early experiments to finished work
  • Build and publish standalone web experiences when appropriate, while identifying and communicating the additional engineering support required for more complex projects
  • Experiment with hardware, physical computing, displays, sensors, embedded systems, and other technologies when projects call for them
  • Collaborate with external engineers, fabricators, technical studios, and other specialists, contributing enough technical fluency to be an effective creative and engineering partner
  • Maintain a high bar for performance, reliability, usability, and craft without allowing conventional technical approaches to unnecessarily constrain an idea

 

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 6+ years of relevant software engineering, creative technology, or creative development experience
  • Deep expertise in at least one area of creative engineering, with demonstrated curiosity and competence across adjacent technologies
  • A portfolio of technically ambitious, highly crafted work such as experimental websites, interactive experiences, realtime graphics, games, installations, creative tools, or other unusual applications of technology
  • Strong frontend engineering fundamentals and experience independently building and shipping public-facing web experiences
  • Strong visual and interaction sensibility, with the ability to faithfully execute sophisticated creative direction and identify opportunities to improve it
  • Experience solving unfamiliar technical problems with a high degree of independence
  • Experience writing thoughtful, maintainable code and making pragmatic engineering decisions in fast-moving environments

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with realtime graphics, WebGL, WebGPU, Three.js, shaders, animation, generative systems, or other forms of creative coding
  • Experience working with hardware, physical computing, embedded systems, sensors, displays, Raspberry Pi, Arduino, or interactive installations
  • Familiarity with backend development, APIs, networking, cloud infrastructure, or other areas beyond frontend engineering
  • Experience collaborating with designers, artists, fabricators, creative studios, or other multidisciplinary partners
  • Experience identifying, evaluating, and directing outside technical specialists when a project extends beyond your own expertise
  • Deep curiosity about technology, design, craft, and the ways new technical capabilities can enable new forms of creative work

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/stripe-creative-engineer-stripe-creative-lab

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description: Headquarters: Remote (Canada) About Clipboard Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S. Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities. About the role: An indispensable component of Clipboard's marketplace is its workplace customers. The Customer Success Manager ensures the continued success of the partnership between Clipboard and its workplace partners, working to deliver an optimal experience at every level of their organizations. The job encompasses being a resource to workplaces when issues arise, liaising with building- and corporate-level contacts, and keeping abreast of a litany of important business metrics for each account. Your week will be balanced between high-touch customer engagement and internal account strategy, with a laser focus on net revenue retention. You are an avid problem-solver, a strategic communicator, and a diligent executor who can navigate complex relationships to sharpen your business acumen. Responsibilities: Manage & grow your portfolio: Own a book of business with accountability for "Same-Store Shift Postings" (SSSP, which measures utilization) and "Same-Store Net Revenue" (SSNR, which measures profitability). In your pursuit of driving those numbers higher, you will identify churn risks, mitigate issues, and proactively uncover opportunities for commercial expansion. Strategic account planning: Build and maintain detailed account plans. Forecast performance accurately and provide regular insights to internal leadership regarding pipeline health and account stability. Drive executive value: Establish trust with both clinical and non-clinical executives. Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and strategic meetings to demonstrate value, align on business goals, and negotiate mutually beneficial outcomes. Operational excellence: Act as the primary point of contact for complex escalations, ensuring rapid resolution while implementing systemic solutions to prevent recurrence. Cross-functional advocacy: Partner with Product, Legal, and Strategy Operations to represent the voice of the customer, driving product improvements and internal initiatives that optimize the client experience. Beyond the basics, what will make you successful: Extreme ownership : The buck stops with you, no matter what anyone else did or did not do. You're self-reliant, and can get things done in the chaos that is an early-stage startup scaling quickly. Extreme curiosity : You ask "why" 3-5 times in a row for the same problem, digging and digging and not being satisfied until you truly understand the root cause. Scrappiness : You look for ways through problems and refuse to let obstacles derail your progress. You bring solutions instead of asking ‘what should I do?’ Fast-paced : You thrive on moving quickly and are highly adaptable to a market that evolves quickly. Our interview process: Application (where you are now!) Case study Interview 1 with a hiring manager Interview 2 with Head of Account Management Culture chat with a partner on our People Team Why a case study first? Since this role is remote and requires a high degree of autonomy, the case study helps us understand how you operate in an asynchronous environment. Specifically, we’re looking at how you interpret written context, navigate ambiguity, and identify opportunities independently. This ensures our first conversation is grounded in your actual work style rather than just a resume walkthrough. Qualifications: Relationship management experience not required but strongly preferred Excellent verbal and written communication skills Willingness to try / lack of fear Bachelor's Degree Benefits: Do great work that matters for customers who could really use your help Competitive pay Unlimited PTO Fully Remote Quick Note on Scammers: Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/clipboard-customer-success-manager

Understanding of networking fundamentals, including the Domain Name System (DNS), load balancing, ingress, and service mesh concepts. Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to document systems and collaborate across teams. About the team The Runway team builds and maintains infrastructure and developer tooling for GitLab's engineering organization. The team collaborates with application teams to onboard services and improve developer productivity through documentation, runbooks, and self-service tooling. You will shape architectures, prove out the hard problems, challenge and influence customer roadmaps, and raise the GenAI capability of the entire EMEA Emerging DNB field organisation.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the deep technical authority on Generative AI, LLMs, and applied machine learning for the EMEA Emerging DNB business unit, supporting the most strategic and complex customer engagements across our digital-native and born-in-the-cloud accounts.
  • Partner with our EMEA Emerging DNB Solutions Architects, Solutions Engineers, and Account teams to scope, design, and de-risk GenAI use cases — from retrieval-augmented generation and agentic systems to fine-tuning and evaluation.
  • Build hands-on proofs of concept and reference implementations that operationalise large-scale LLM and deep learning workloads on Databricks (Mosaic AI, MLflow, Model Serving, Vector Search, Unity Catalog governance), tuned to the fast iteration cycles Emerging DNB customers expect.
  • Lead fine-tuning and model-customisation engagements on open LLMs (e.g., Llama-family models), including judge-based and label-efficient evaluation approaches for domains where quality and safety are paramount.
  • Act as a bridge to Product and Engineering — channel field and customer feedback into the roadmap and represent the roadmap back to the field.
  • Enable and mentor the broader EMEA Emerging DNB Field Engineering team through workshops, reference architectures, and internal enablement, multiplying GenAI expertise across our ~70-person SA/SE organisation.
  • Represent Databricks externally as a technical thought leader — conference talks (e.g., Data + AI Summit), blogs, and customer executive briefings.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong understanding of the LLM landscape, including leading proprietary and open-source models and providers, with the ability to differentiate their capabilities, trade-offs, and suitability for different use cases, and to articulate a clear, informed point of view (POV) to customers.
  • Deep expertise in the modern GenAI stack: LLM application patterns (RAG, agents, tool use), fine-tuning and model customization, prompt and evaluation engineering, and LLM guardrails/safety.
  • Strong foundations in machine learning and deep learning, including distributed training, GPU workloads, and the full MLOps lifecycle (tracking, registry, serving, monitoring).
  • Proficiency in Python and the ML ecosystem (PyTorch/Transformers, MLflow, Spark), and comfort building production-quality reference implementations.
  • Experience with the Databricks platform — or the ability to ramp on it quickly — including Mosaic AI, Model Serving, Vector Search, and Unity Catalog. Cloud experience across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Excellent communication and consultative skills: able to earn the trust of both hands-on engineers and senior technical executives, and to explain complex GenAI trade-offs clearly.
  • A track record of technical leadership and mentorship — someone who elevates the people around them.
  • Comfort operating at the pace of digital-native and high-growth customers, where speed, iteration, and technical credibility win the deal.
  • Based in the United Kingdom and able to work across EMEA time zones, with willingness to travel to customer sites within the region as needed.
  • Background helping digital-native customers build data and ML solutions (e.g., prior experience at a data/ML platform or consulting vendor) is a strong plus.

Nice to Have

  • Public technical presence: conference speaking, published talks, blogs, or open-source contributions in the ML/GenAI space.
  • Domain depth in a regulated or high-stakes industry (healthcare/life sciences, financial services) where model quality, evaluation, and safety are critical.
  • Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmap.

Why This Role

You will work on the hardest and most exciting GenAI problems our EMEA Emerging DNB customers have — companies building the future in real time — with the platform and the people to actually solve them, not just advise. You'll shape how one of EMEA's highest-growth business units adopts Generative AI, influence the direction of the product, and build a public profile as a recognised expert in the field. This is the role for a builder and a teacher, who wants their expertise to have outsized impact.

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
